description: Agent-based, networked simulation of mask adoption and wearing behavior with social influence, policy, media, and market constraints. Individuals are nodes in a small-world social network interacting with households, locations, retailers, media, and policy enforcement.

parameters.income_aggregation: Mean of members with correlation household_income_correlation

parameters.message_valence: Centered on campaign_effect_size when campaigns run, else 0

modules.name: SocialInfluenceModule
modules.description: Updates individual mask attitudes and wearing probability using observed peer behavior, household norms, and group influence on the social network.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  observed = mean(mask_wearing of neighbors over last peer_observation_window days with decay neighbor_memory_decay)
  noise = Normal(0, decision_noise)
  group_influence = group_membership_influence_weight * mean(mask_wearing among same-group neighbors)
  household_influence = household_norms_weight * Household[i.household_id].norms_mask_use
  homophily_adj = homophily_bias * (mean(attitude of neighbors similar in income/age) - i.mask_attitude)
  i.mask_attitude = clip(i.mask_attitude + i.social_influence_susceptibility * social_influence_weight * ((observed + group_influence + household_influence)/max(1e-6, (1+group_membership_influence_weight+household_norms_weight)) - i.mask_attitude) + homophily_adj + noise, 0, 1)
  i.mask_wearing_probability = clip(0.5*i.mask_wearing_probability + 0.5*i.mask_attitude, 0, 1)
notes: Decay weights recent observations more heavily.
network_observation_noise can be applied when constructing observed mask wearing from neighbors.

modules.name: MediaAndCampaignModule
modules.description: Broadcasts media messages and campaign effects to update individuals' risk perception, trust, and mask attitudes.

notes: Misinformation reduces effective message_valence or reverses it depending on rate.
media_bias_polarization shapes message_valence around campaigns; outside campaign, mean valence is 0.

modules.name: PolicyAndEnforcementModule
modules.description: Manages policy state transitions, computes policy pressure, and contributes to enforcement probability at locations.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if policy_mandate_day >= 0 and day == policy_mandate_day: set policy_state='mandate'
if policy_mandate_end_day >= 0 and day == policy_mandate_end_day: set policy_state='recommendation'
policy_pressure = 0
if policy_state == 'mandate':
  policy_pressure = enforcement_intensity * log(1 + fine_amount)
for each location L:
  L.enforcement_signal = L.enforcement_level * enforcement_intensity
notes: policy_pressure is used by DecisionAndActionModule to adjust wearing probability.
If no mandate (negative day), policy remains at initial state.

modules.name: RetailMarketModule
modules.description: Handles retailer inventory dynamics, pricing, and sales to agents under rationing.

update_rule.pseudocode:
daily_demand = 0
for each retailer r:
  r.inventory += Poisson(restock_rate_per_day * population_size/num_retailers)
  r.inventory = max(r.inventory, 0)
for each person i with purchase_intent:
  choose retailer r uniformly
  qty = min(rationing_limit_per_purchase, max(0, purchase_threshold_stock - i.mask_stock))
  sold = min(qty, r.inventory)
  i.mask_stock += sold
  r.inventory -= sold
  daily_demand += qty
# price adjustment
for each retailer r:
  demand_signal = (daily_demand/num_retailers) - r.inventory
  r.price = max(0.1, r.price * (1 + price_adjust_sensitivity * tanh(demand_signal / max(1, r.inventory))))
# observables
supply = sum(r.inventory)
demand = daily_demand
supply_demand_gap_daily = demand - supply
emit observables
notes: Purchases are constrained by rationing and inventory.
Price elasticity impacts future purchase intent (used in DecisionAndActionModule).

modules.name: MobilityAndLocationModule
modules.description: Simulates daily movement across locations; applies access control and logs noncompliance events.

notes: Access denial and penalties do not directly change stock but affect future compliance via DecisionAndActionModule through policy_pressure feedback.

modules.name: DecisionAndActionModule
modules.description: Per-person decisions: wear mask, purchase masks, habit formation and fatigue dynamics, and response to policy pressure.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  # habit and fatigue updates
  i.habit_strength = clip(i.habit_strength + habit_formation_rate*(1 if i.mask_wearing else -1), 0, 1)
  i.fatigue = clip(i.fatigue + fatigue_rate*(1 if i.mask_wearing else -0.5), 0, 1)
  # wear decision logistic
  x = wear_logit_coeff_attitude*i.mask_attitude + wear_logit_coeff_risk*i.risk_perception + wear_logit_coeff_policy*(global.policy_pressure*compliance_sensitivity*i.compliance_propensity) + wear_logit_coeff_habit*i.habit_strength + wear_logit_coeff_fatigue*i.fatigue
  p_wear = sigmoid(x)
  if i.mask_stock <= 0: p_wear = 0
  i.mask_wearing = Bernoulli(p_wear)
  if i.mask_wearing: i.mask_stock = max(0, i.mask_stock - 1/3)  # one mask used for ~3 days reuse
  # household sharing
  H = Household[i.household_id]
  if i.mask_stock < 1 and H.mask_stock > 0 and Bernoulli(household_sharing_efficiency):
    H.mask_stock -= 1
    i.mask_stock += 1
  # purchase intent
  desired_stock = purchase_threshold_stock
  affordability = sigmoid(-price_elasticity * mean_retail_price)
  if i.mask_stock < desired_stock and day - i.last_purchase_day >= min_days_between_purchases and Bernoulli(affordability):
    i.purchase_intent = true
    i.last_purchase_day = day
  else:
    i.purchase_intent = false
notes: Mask consumption rate approximated by one mask every three days if wearing.
affordability uses price_elasticity; more negative reduces purchase probabilities as price rises.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Computes daily observables and aggregates by groups for evaluation and calibration.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate_daily = mean(Person.mask_wearing)
peak_adoption = max(peak_adoption, adoption_rate_daily)
if adoption_rate_daily >= adoption_threshold and time_to_threshold not set: time_to_threshold = day
# disparity by income quantiles
assign quantiles by income into disparity_group_quantiles
adoption_by_income_quintile = group_mean(mask_wearing)
# policy effect (difference-in-differences over 7-day windows)
if policy_mandate_day >= 0:
  pre = mean(adoption_rate_daily over days [policy_mandate_day-7, policy_mandate_day-1])
  post = mean(adoption_rate_daily over days [policy_mandate_day+1, policy_mandate_day+7])
  policy_effect_delta = post - pre
# campaign attitude shift over 5-day windows after campaign days
for each campaign_day in campaign_schedule:
  shift = mean(mask_attitude days [campaign_day+1..campaign_day+5]) - mean(mask_attitude days [campaign_day-5..campaign_day-1])
  store campaign_attitude_shift as average over campaigns
notes: Observables are persisted daily; peak metrics tracked incrementally.
If no mandate, policy_effect_delta remains null.

observables.formula_or_field: mean(mask_attitude post 5 days) - mean(mask_attitude pre 5 days) averaged across campaigns

initialization.network_generation: Watts-Strogatz small-world with average_degree and rewire_prob
initialization.household_assignment: Sequentially pack agents into households using Poisson(household_size_mean), ensure sum equals population
initialization.person_attributes: Sample age, income, compliance, susceptibility, initial attitude, trust; compute group_memberships (e.g., income quintile, age group), assign mask_stock ~ Poisson(initial_personal_stock_mean)
initialization.media_sources: Instantiate num_media_sources with reach, credibility, bias; assign each person k sources (k ~ Poisson(1.5) truncated >=1) weighted by reach
initialization.locations: Create work/school/retail/transit pools with capacities = capacity_utilization * population_size / count
initialization.retailers: Create num_retailers with initial inventory = initial_inventory_per_capita * population_size / num_retailers and price = mask_price
initialization.policy: Set policy_initial_state and schedule campaign_start_day + multiples of campaign_frequency_days

algorithms.NetworkGeneration: Watts–Strogatz small-world graph G(N, k=average_degree, beta=rewire_prob)
algorithms.AttitudeUpdate: Weighted-averaging with decay, household norms and group influence, plus Gaussian noise
algorithms.WearDecision: Logistic regression on attitude, risk, policy pressure, habit, fatigue; constrained by stock
algorithms.HabitFatigueDynamics: Increment/decrement habit and fatigue based on wearing
algorithms.MarketMechanism: Inventory restocking via Poisson, rationed sales, price adaptation via tanh of excess demand
algorithms.MobilityAndEnforcement: Sampled visits by location mix, enforcement based on location signal and enforcement noise
algorithms.MediaCampaign: Campaign days boost risk and attitude; misinformation attenuates; baseline drift on other days
algorithms.Aggregation: Daily means and grouped means; time-to-threshold and difference-in-differences around policy
